newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR rates mixed, short-term lower.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR rates mixed, short-term lower.

text.p: The Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) were mixed on Tuesday as rates aligned with recent trends, traders said.
The one and two-week maturities fell following the easing of rates at the money market on Tuesday after banks squared their positions, traders said.

But the two-month, three-month and six-month rates rose as banks adjusted swap rates in line with the rise in the three-month and six-month Treasury bill rates in Monday's regular weekly auction, dealers said.
